description: A ground-level photograph captures a landscape primarily composed of various land cover types. In the foreground, there is an expanse of bright green grassland, interspersed with numerous clumps of taller, brownish-green, rush-like vegetation. Behind this, a horizontal strip of dense, dry, straw-coloured vegetation with some green patches separates the foreground from the background. The background features a dense, uniformly planted coniferous forest covering a gentle slope or hillside, suggesting a managed forest or plantation. The sky above is overcast and bright.
